description: Everyday dog-care questions a guardian asks (2026-10-10), written before measuring. Each has a general answer a vet would give without examining the dog, so abstaining is over-abstention. Prompted by '심장사상충 약 얼마나 자주 먹여야 돼요?' answering that the material had nothing on it.
